desc: Ideation: reduce each answer to the largest divisor d of A_i with at least K array elements divisible by d, and choose prime-based zeta transforms for counting multiples and max-over-divisors.
Fix the K == N output bug so the whole-array gcd is printed on N separate lines.
Verify the implementation on all public samples and edge cases (K=1, K=N, M=1, all equal, random small brute-force checks).
